hero.description: Miliyoyin marasa galihu har yanzu ba su da hanyar samun lafiya, ilimi da dama. CHADI na canza wannan — rai ɗaya, al'umma ɗaya a lokaci guda.
hero.impactBadge: Sama da rayuka {{count}}+ da aka taɓa

aboutPreview.title: Ƙirƙirar Tasiri Mai Dorewa a Cikin Al'ummomi
aboutPreview.p1: CHADI International ƙungiya ce mai zaman kanta da ke sadaukar da kai wajen inganta rayuwa ta hanyar ilimi, kiwon lafiya, sabuntawa, dorewar muhalli, taimakon jin ƙai da ƙarfafa matasa.
aboutPreview.p2: Mun yi imani da cewa canji mai dorewa yana faruwa ne lokacin da al'ummomi suka zama masu himma a cikin ci gaban kansu.

whyChooseUs.title: Me Ya Sa CHADI International?
whyChooseUs.subtitle: Ƙirƙirar canji mai dorewa ta hanyar sabuntawa, haɗin gwiwa da jagorancin al'umma.

community.title: Al'umma Ce Ke Jagoranta
community.description: Ana tsara kowane shiga tsakani tare da al'ummomin gida domin tabbatar da tasiri mai dorewa.

inclusive.title: Ci Gaba Mai Haɗa Kai
inclusive.description: Muna ƙarfafa waɗanda aka ware ba tare da la'akari da shekaru, jinsi ko nakasa ba.

innovation.title: Sabuntawa
innovation.description: Fasaha, ƙirƙira da bincike suna jagorantar shirye-shiryenmu don ci gaba mai dorewa.

sustainable.title: Tasiri Mai Dorewa
sustainable.description: Ayyukanmu suna mayar da hankali kan canji na dogon lokaci maimakon taimako na wucin gadi.

focusAreas.title: Fannonin Da Muke Mai da Hankali A Kai
focusAreas.subtitle: CHADI International tana ƙirƙirar mafita mai dorewa da ke inganta rayuwa da ƙarfafa al'ummomi ta hanyar shirye-shiryen ci gaba masu haɗaka.

education.title: Ilimi
education.description: Inganta samun ilimi mai inganci, karatu da damar koyo na rayuwa.

healthcare.title: Kiwon Lafiya
healthcare.description: Ƙarfafa tsarin kiwon lafiya da inganta jin daɗin al'umma.

environment.title: Muhalli
environment.description: Ƙarfafa aikin yanayi, kiyaye muhalli da ayyukan muhalli masu dorewa.

innovation.title: Sabuntawa
innovation.description: Amfani da fasaha da sabuntawa don magance ƙalubalen zamantakewa da tattalin arziki.

humanitarian.title: Taimakon Jin Ƙai
humanitarian.description: Bayar da agajin gaggawa da tallafi na dogon lokaci ga waɗanda ke cikin rauni.

youth.title: Ƙarfafa Matasa
youth.description: Ƙirƙirar dama don jagoranci, ƙirƙirar kasuwanci da haɓaka ƙwarewa.

impactCounter.title: Tasirinmu A Cikin Lambobi
impactCounter.subtitle: Kowane aiki yana wakiltar rayuwar da aka canza da al'ummomin da aka ƙarfafa.

impactAreas.title: Ƙirƙirar Canji Mai Dorewa
impactAreas.description: Kowane aiki yana ba da gudummawa ga al'ummomi masu lafiya, ingantaccen ilimi, iyalai masu ƙarfi, da ci gaba mai dorewa.

visionMission.title: Manufarmu
visionMission.subtitle: Ƙirƙirar tasiri mai dorewa ta hanyar ƙarfafa waɗanda aka ware da al'ummomin da ba a kula da su ba.

vision.title: Hangen Nesa
vision.description: Ƙarfafa waɗanda aka ware da al'ummomin da ba a kula da su ba ta hanyar ci gaba mai dorewa, sabuntawa, ilimi, kiwon lafiya da shiga tsakani na jin ƙai.

mission.title: Manufa
mission.description: Tsarawa da aiwatar da shirye-shirye masu sabuntawa da ke inganta lafiya, ilimi, rayuwa, dorewar muhalli, zaman lafiya, samun fasaha da juriyar al'umma a fadin Afirka.

successStories.title: Labaran Nasara
successStories.subtitle: Labarai masu ƙarfafa gwiwa na rayuwar da aka canza ta hanyar shirye-shiryen CHADI International da ayyukan al'umma.
successStories.empty: Labaran daga al'umma suna kan hanya.

featuredProjects.title: Ƙirƙirar Tasiri Mai Dorewa
featuredProjects.subtitle: Ta hanyar shirye-shirye masu sabuntawa da haɗin gwiwa mai dabara, CHADI International tana canza rayuwa a fadin al'ummomin da ba a kula da su ba.

latestNews.title: Sabuntawa Daga CHADI
latestNews.subtitle: Bi diddigin ci gaban shirye-shirye, ayyukan filin da labaran al'umma.

partnersSection.title: An Gina Tare Da Al'ummomi
partnersSection.description: CHADI tana haɗin gwiwa da amintattun abokan hulɗa don isar da shirye-shirye masu amfani, masu ɗawainiya kuma tushen su daga ainihin yanayin gida.

upcomingEvents.title: Ayyukan Da Ke Tafe
upcomingEvents.seeEvents: Duba Abubuwan Da Za Su Faru

callToAction.title: A Shirye Kuke Don Tallafa Wa Tasirin Al'umma Mai Dorewa?
callToAction.description: Ba da agaji, haɗa kai, bayar da gudummawa ko gayyaci CHADI zuwa buƙatar al'umma da ta cancanci aiki mai amfani.
